Based on my analysis of the codebase, here are all the documents and source files that need to be updated when adding a new member to the shared error-code union:

**Source files:**
1. `src/types/api.ts` - The `ErrorCode` type union definition (lines 7-16)
2. `src/lib/errors.ts` - The `HTTP_STATUS_BY_CODE` mapping (lines 18-28) must include an HTTP status for the new code
3. `tests/lib/errors.test.ts` - Tests need to be updated to verify the new code is in `HTTP_STATUS_BY_CODE`

**Documentation files:**
1. `docs/adr/ADR-014-domain-errors-to-error-codes.md` - The ADR documents the closed union and all nine codes; needs to be updated with the new code, its HTTP status, and the corresponding error class
2. `docs/api/actions-overview.md` - Contains the error translation table (lines 204-218) that lists all error codes and their HTTP statuses
3. `docs/design/action-wrapper-and-errors.md` - Describes the nine `ErrorCode` values in `HTTP_STATUS_BY_CODE` (line 98) and references the union in the context of action-layer error classes

ANSWER: src/types/api.ts, src/lib/errors.ts, tests/lib/errors.test.ts, docs/adr/ADR-014-domain-errors-to-error-codes.md, docs/api/actions-overview.md, docs/design/action-wrapper-and-errors.md
